name: chains_impact
for: hollow_magistrate chains (hit at the hero's feet)
notes: The manacle arrives along the floor (+x), snaps shut on the shin with a hard clank (4-ray glint, 1-frame hit-stop, sparks, grit and a dust burst), the chain whips round into a loop about the ankle (back links darker), the slack falls and settles on the ground, then the whole chain crumbles away in blocks on the last frames. Anchor = ground under the ankle (feet).
